attempts.text:
The plan makes two round trips from the shelter, and no one is deferred.

1. **Benighat care home:** a 12-minute round trip brings back the 2 elderly people. Deferring them would cost 100, so this is worth it.
2. **Thakre care home and Dhunche school:** one 132-minute loop collects the 2 elderly people at Thakre and the 2 children at Dhunche, filling all 4 seats. The car brings them back through Thakre to the shelter.

Total driving is 12 + 132 = 144 minutes.

The alternatives cost more:
- Skipping the Dhunche children and doing only the two care homes costs 12 + 72 + 120 in penalties = 204.
- Carrying the Benighat elderly on the Thakre loop doesn't work, because the car would then have no room for the children.

<plan>
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter benighat-care-home
load car1 elderly 2
drive car1 benighat-care-home tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 elderly 2
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter thakre-care-home
load car1 elderly 2
drive car1 thakre-care-home dhunche-school
load car1 child 2
drive car1 dhunche-school thakre-care-home
drive car1 thakre-care-home tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 elderly 2
unload car1 child 2
</plan>
COST: 144
